ns2:section.sectionText: This course is only for students that are in the Computer Science MCS-DS Program. Additional ProctorU fees may apply. Description: The course is intended to support students who wish to apply machine learning methods, and will focus on tool-oriented and problem-oriented exposition. Application areas include computer vision, natural language, interpreting accelerometer data, and understanding audio data.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC or MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC.
